    outcome = neutral

    desc = oe_trs.1.d
    trigger = { is_rebel_country = no tag = BYZ has_variable = oe_trs_theme }

        name = oe_trs.1.a
        custom_tooltip = oe_trs.1.a.tt
        add_gold = -200
        hidden_effect = { location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_trs_bizye_water years = 20 mode = replace } } } }
        ai_chance = { base = 35 modifier = { factor = 0.25 gold < 400 } }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_trs.1.b
        custom_tooltip = oe_trs.1.b.tt
        add_gold = -50
        hidden_effect = { var:oe_trs_theme ?= { oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -5 } } var:oe_trs_theme ?= { oe_ts_recent_eff = { line = 5 amount = 15 } } location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_trs_bizye_water years = 20 mode = replace } } } }

    }

    }
